text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary /v3/stream memory usage > 90% (OOM risk) for variant=quantized in us-west-2 for 4m. Autorevert candidate: v3.3.9. Options: (1) rollback quantized variant only, (2) pin runtime kernel, (3) throttle requests. https://telemetry.internal/alerts/1722223334

Nina: saw a few evicted pods and a couple of 502s. This looks like a memory regression introduced by the new allocator patch.

Omar: agree we should not touch full canary. Targeted rollback of variant=quantized seems lowest blast radius. Throttling could cause queue buildup.

Priya: +1 for variant rollback. Also want an explicit audit entry and a short release-note addendum.

infra-bot: Proposed command (holding 45s for objections):
```
releases rollback --to v3.3.9 --scope canary --selectors region=us-west-2,variant=quantized --note "memory spike"
```

legal-bot: Reminder: capture audit_id and avoid promising root cause in customer comms. Tag legal if wording mentions "allocator bug" publicly.

support: Two customer tickets opened referencing intermittent 502s; flagged as possibly impacted. I'll prepare templated blurb pending rollback outcome.

Nina: no objections. Go ahead.

infra-bot: executing now. tail: 
```
$ releases rollback --to v3.3.9 --scope canary --selectors region=us-west-2,variant=quantized --note "memory spike"
Rolling back canary slice [us-west-2 variant=quantized] to v3.3.9...
- cordon new pods -> OK
- update variant routing -> OK
- smoke verify -> memory stable, no evictions (within 2m)
Rollback complete. audit_id=rb-20240418-5512
```

Omar: telemetry confirms memory dropped and 502s subsided. :thumbsup:

Priya: posted internal note and added a one-line release-note: "Canary variant rollback (quantized) due to memory regression; no production traffic affected." Legal reviewed wording.

legal-bot: Audit entry captured. No customer-facing technical root cause language used.

support: Blurb sent to affected tickets. Will monitor for follow-ups.

Nina: created follow-up ticket ENG-6203 to bisect allocator patch and test on staging. Keeping prod pinned to the newer image until we have a verified fix for quantized variant.

deploy-bot: NOTE: autorevert suppressed by operator override at execution time."
